newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Gov Pataki seeks federal aid for storm floods.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Gov Pataki seeks federal aid for storm floods.

text.p: Gov. George Pataki on Monday asked the federal government for help to deal with the damage and costs run up by New York City and four surrounding counties due to last month's severe nor'easter.

Pataki said high winds, heavy rains, higher-than-normal tides and flooding caused $18.6 million of damage to public infrastrure and other costs incurred by local goverments responding to the disruptions.
A total of 2,500 residences in the areas that were hit, New York City and the counties of Nassau, Rockland, Suffok and Westchester were damaged in floods.
"While the combined state and local government response has been outstanding in reducing human suffering, the financial impact on local budgets has been devasting," Pataki said, in prepared remarks.
